product.workspaceDesc: A unified space to manage your organization's resources, people, and projects. Everything at your fingertips.
product.projectsDesc: Organize work into projects with customizable boards, lists, and timelines tailored to your team's needs.
product.roadmapDesc: Plan your milestones and track long-term progress with an interactive roadmap view.
product.issuesDesc: Detailed issue tracking that supports states, priorities, assignees, and complex hierarchies.
product.workDesc: Personal work management: everything you are working on, prioritized and organized.
product.collaborationDesc: Seamlessly communicate within context. Comments, mentions, and activity feeds keeping everyone on the same page.
product.viewsDesc: Create and save custom views to filter and display issues exactly the way you want to see them.
